senses.gloss: ch. (b. h. אָכַף, √כף, v. כפף), denomin. of אוכָּף, to ride on a saddled ass.
units: <cite ref="Niddah 14a:5">Nidd. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>הא דמֵיכַף וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>דמַכַּף</he> = <he>מְאַכַּף</he> Pa.) in the one case it means that he rides on a saddled ass. [<he>מיכף</he> <cite ref="Sanhedrin 36a">Snh. 36ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="K00334"><he>כּוּף</he></cite>.]
